info.name: SSO Core — Complete API
info.description: Generated from docs/openapi.json. Read postman/README.md before use. Do not Run All: administration, revocation, secret rotation and deletion mutate data. Start OAuth in a browser for real callback testing. Cookie jar holds HttpOnly cookies. Mobile requests require real Ed25519 signatures; no bypass exists.

request.description: Browser navigation endpoint. Validates registered redirect URI and scopes; public clients require PKCE. Creates an AuthSession and redirects to login/consent. state must be random, stored by the client, and verified at callback. Use a new verifier (43–128 chars) per attempt; S256 = base64url(SHA256(verifier)).

item.name: Exchange code or rotate refresh token

request.description: Accepts JSON and application/x-www-form-urlencoded. authorization_code requires code, redirect_uri and client identity; code_verifier required if PKCE was used. Confidential clients require secret via Basic or body. refresh_token requires refresh_token and matching client credentials; rotates refresh tokens (replace stored values). ID token is returned on authorization_code, not refresh. Authorization codes are single-use.

request.description:
Returns all devices including revoked ones. Pairing token is one-use and valid 10 minutes. QR endpoint uses configured origin or development LAN IP. Treat token as sensitive.

request.description:
Two distinct bodies: {action:"generate",password} requires an authenticated session and correct password; creates 10 codes, shown once, replacing all old codes. {challengeId,code} requires password-step sso_challenge cookie; consumes code exactly once and approves pending challenge. Poll challenge-status afterward to finish login. Five failed recovery attempts per account in 15 minutes trigger 429.
